entries.summary: The official Pi closure is pinned to exactly 1.5.0 and adds @earendil-works/pi-schema as its tenth package (upstream commit f9a26365); the closureDigest changes, so a preparation compiled for 1.4.0 declines with preparation_runtime_identity_mismatch until it is prepared again. pi-durable migrates a replica forward on open (pi.live v3, pi.tool v3, pi.generation v2) and a 0.36.0 build cannot open it afterwards, so a device or Durable Object cannot roll back past this release. A crash, eviction or reset while a model request is in flight no longer sends that request again: the run ends unanswered with reason interrupted, which the client durable lane reports as runtime_exited ('durable runtime was interrupted during a model request') and cloud-do as CLOUD_EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED, as before. Streamed progress reaches durable storage within about one second instead of on every update. cloud-do: CloudToolDefinition.parameters is pi-schema-typed, so build tool schemas with Type from typebox or with pi-schema builders, not with Type from @earendil-works/pi-ai, which no longer exports it; arguments are coerced before validation ("42" to 42, one value to an array, null to an omitted optional property) and the validation messages the model sees changed. A DurableObjectSqliteDatabase implementation must provide runCounted. keys: PI_MODEL_CATALOG_PI_AI_VERSION is 1.5.0, and 30 entries Pi 1.5.0 dropped return not_in_catalog. A lane that does not pass the Host system prompt gets Pi 1.5.0's tightened default prompt.
